pairs.subject: production-pipeline-phasing
pairs.evidence: apps/console/fidelity/run.mjs:7 This context holds only quality instruments: a style-contract fidelity gate that renders console pages against a prototype, plus bundle, DOM and perf-count budgets. It runs no multi-phase media production, renders no assets or disposables, starts no long generation jobs and aggregates no phase progress. A case-insensitive grep of budgets/, fidelity/ and src/perf/ for graduat, phase, narration, storyboard and background_job returned nothing. Other terms only hit unrelated senses: 'worst' means the worst DOM scene, 'progress' is the onair-progress selector, and 'promot' is the UI contest promotion steps.
